New Century

Kathleen Collins played one of the various Blackbirds and titled it the New Century for some reason. Puzzling that she would have the same title for a different hornpipe her ex-husband recorded. Yet another New Century is in Ryan’s and was recorded on cylinder a century ago by violinst José Zaffiro.

The O’Neill’s setting has one sharp; Joe or some other Galwegian flattened that F to give this tune its monolithic sound.

↳ Posted by Lucy Rietmann on December 1st, 2012.

The New Century, X:5

I can’t remember for the life of me where I got this setting from but it seems like a mix of both Padraig Rynne and Molloy/Keane/McGlynn settings — and a mix of the two main versions posted on this page. I like it that way!
